description: Approved SPDX license identifiers permitted in the bundled CLI and its published install-time dependency closure. BlueOak-1.0.0 approval was confirmed by the operator on 2026-10-31. Upstream's Python-2.0 allowance is not adopted pending internal approval. Anything else, including copyleft, source-available, proprietary, and unknown licenses, blocks release; there is no exception mechanism.
